name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Lifecycle & CRM Marketing | Segmentation, Automated Journeys & Retention
summary: Lifecycle and CRM marketer who builds the automated journeys and writes the messages. At Solenzo I designed a 20+ workflow lifecycle system covering welcome, post-purchase onboarding, reviews, long-term nurture, and reactivation of lapsed customers. At Wix I helped established retailers launch online stores, across an e-commerce segment that saw a 30% traffic lift and 25% conversion improvement. I segment on behavior and lifecycle stage, build custom tracking events, and read the results myself.

experience.title: Lifecycle & CRM Marketing Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected a 20+ workflow email and SMS lifecycle system: welcome, qualification, booking confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding, nurture and reactivation, and review generation.
Set up sending domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication, and warm-up myself, holding email deliverability above 99%.
Design segmentation, lifecycle stages, and lead scoring on customer behavior and engagement, and personalize messaging using AI-scored signals.
Write the email copy and sequences myself, then track results in GA4 and CRM analytics and iterate on what the data shows.
Build custom GA4 conversion events, triggers, and variables in Google Tag Manager, validated in Preview mode and browser developer tools.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced multi-touch email sequences, landing pages, and conversion copy for client campaigns.
Built campaign reporting tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, with optimization recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Built automated training and communication sequences and advised 15-20 partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, retaining all but one (~94%).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Built and launched e-commerce sites for established retailers adding an online storefront alongside their physical locations.
Managed a high-value account portfolio contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led multiple onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, running weekly training and 1:1 coaching.
